column7: ActivateMFA audited mfa.failed -- the same event a wrong or replayed code produces -- when MarkTOTPStepUsed hit a STORAGE error, so a user finishing enrolment with the CORRECT code during a DB hiccup read, on review, exactly like a guess. Last site in the family #2398/#2740/#2743 established. No recordFailedLogin is reachable here, so the consequence is audit accuracy only, not lockout -- stated rather than inflated. Fixed by splitting the ferr != nil branch (audit mfa.error, return ErrMFAVerificationStorageFailure) from the ferr == nil && !fresh branch (a CONFIRMED replay, which stays mfa.failed). The test pins BOTH halves, because over-correcting the replay case into mfa.error would lose a real failed-attempt signal; it also asserts the same correct code still activates once the fault clears, i.e. the storage error did not consume the step. Red-proven by mutation
